messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty PD-71234 fired for service=db-primary - metric=pg.connections > 95% of max (alert threshold). Auto-retries failing.
pagerduty: Incident PD-71234 created and notified on-call. Escalation policy: eng-oncall -> sre-lead if unacked for 5m.
alex.k: acked PD-71234 :hand: looking. Any idea what started it?
maya.r: seeing a big tail from a backfill job that kicked off ~09:02 UTC, lots of ORM connections not returning. p99_conn ~ 4.2k, p95 qdepth pgbouncer=900.
ryan.s: confirmed - backup/backfill batch job `user_events_backfill` spikes DB connections. I can pause it if needed.
alex.k: pause it please. Also grabbing `pg_stat_activity` now.
ryan.s: paused the backfill job (killed controller). command: `kubectl scale job user-events-backfill --replicas=0` — returned 0 replicas.
oncall-bot: System note: backfill job paused by ryan.s at 1765004400.
maya.r: pg_stat_activity shows many idle in transaction from service=analytics-worker, duration ~5-8m. Looks like connection leak.
ryan.s: pgbouncer shows pool_stalls and waiters; `SHOW STATS` snippet: ```total_request=124k, average_wait=180ms, waiters=1120, cl_active=2200```
alex.k: immediate mitigations: 1) increase pgbouncer max_client_conn from 5000->8000 (short-term) 2) reduce analytics concurrency to 50% 3) enable connection throttling for batch namespace. I'll apply 1 now.
sre-lead: +1 on throttling. Also prep read-only failover for a subset of traffic if latency stays high.
alex.k: applying pgbouncer config bump (rolling restart). Command: ```helm upgrade pgbouncer --set maxClientConn=8000 chart/pgbouncer -n infra --wait --timeout 5m```
oncall-bot: pgbouncer rolling restart started at 1765004520. Expect ~30s per pod.
maya.r: after restart client waiters dropped to ~200, db connections dropped to ~2.6k, p50 latency improved. Still seeing some 500s from API gateway to DB during earlier window.
cs-ops-bot: Customer-impact note: ~0.8% of write requests returned 5xx between 09:02-09:14 UTC. No major customer-facing outage, but degraded writes for some tenants.
ryan.s: switching analytics workers to limited concurrency now: `kubectl patch deployment analytics-worker -p '{"spec":{"replicas":10}}'` and scaling job controllers.
alex.k: adding rate-limit rule to gateway to shed non-critical analytics writes: config applied.
sre-lead: good work. Monitoring p99_conn and pgbouncer waiters for next 15m. If metrics stable, we'll close PD and create follow-up postmortem.
oncall-bot: PD-71234 acknowledged by alex.k at 1765004412.
pagerduty: PD-71234 status updated: acknowledged -> mitigated.
maya.r: metrics look steady for 8m: p99_conn < 3k, waiters < 150, write errors trending down.
alex.k: preparing handoff notes for next on-call: root cause suspected connection leak in analytics backfill; immediate fix = job pause + pgbouncer bump + gateway shedding. Will open a tracking ticket.
sre-lead: please include remediation steps and timeline in ticket. Also assign to eng-platform + analytics to add connection pooling fixes and circuit-breaker.
cs-ops-bot: Notifying CS: small set of customers saw transient write failures; no data loss reported.
alex.k: closing PD in 10m if stable. Handoff to maya.r for overnight watch.
maya.r: taking handoff. I'll check alerts every 30m and verify there's no regression after the backfill resume window.
oncall-bot: Thread closed for active paging; follow-up ticket created: TKT-1890 (connection-leak-backfill) at 1765004860.
